description: DCP-AI admission vectors (spec/profiles/admission/README.md). Each case gives a signed bundle, the clock (now), the profile, the trust set and the revocation snapshot, and the outcome every SDK MUST produce: verified, principal_trust, profile_compliance, admitted, recorded_decision, action_authorized (always false) and the sorted set of error codes. revocation is evaluated under a profile only; null means the source could not answer. config_cases MUST be refused with expected_code; accepted_profiles MUST load with the given effective limits. Expected values come from the spec, not from any implementation.

cases.name: A_known_principal_strict
cases.reason: Known principal, both principal keys trusted and active, coherent bundle, right audience, 300 s session, fresh revocation snapshot: admitted.

cases.name: B_general_verifier_unchanged
cases.reason: No trust set and no profile: the verifier's verdict alone, nothing else evaluated.

cases.name: B_trust_without_profile
cases.reason: A trust set without the profile: the principal is trusted, the bundle admitted under the default policy.

cases.name: C_new_key_added_to_trust_set
cases.reason: Bundle signed with new keys the operator added to the trust set: admitted.

cases.name: C_new_key_not_yet_in_trust_set
cases.reason: The same bundle before the operator added the new keys: not anchored.

cases.name: D_overlap_old_keys_still_active
cases.reason: During the overlap the old keys stay active: a bundle signed with them is admitted.

cases.name: D_overlap_old_keys_after_retirement
cases.reason: After the rotation the old keys are retired in the trust set: a bundle signed with them is refused.

cases.name: D_overlap_ended_old_keys
cases.reason: The overlap ended one millisecond before now: a bundle signed with the old keys is refused.

cases.name: D_overlap_ended_new_keys
cases.reason: After the overlap a bundle signed with the new keys is admitted.

cases.name: D_new_keys_valid_from_now
cases.reason: not_before equal to now is not after now: the new keys are valid.

cases.name: D_new_keys_before_not_before
cases.reason: New keys whose not_before is one millisecond after now: not valid yet.

cases.name: E_escalated_decision_is_evidence
cases.reason: A bundle recording an escalate decision is admitted as evidence; action_authorized stays false.

cases.name: E_blocked_decision_is_evidence
cases.reason: A bundle recording a block decision is admitted as evidence; action_authorized stays false.

cases.name: 1_unknown_principal_strict
cases.reason: A self-consistent bundle from a principal the trust set does not list: verified, not admitted.

cases.name: 1_empty_trust_set
cases.reason: An empty trust set trusts no one.

cases.name: 1_unknown_principal_trust_only
cases.reason: The same bundle under the default policy with a trust set: verified, not admitted.

cases.name: 11_v1_bundle_trust_only
cases.reason: With a trust set and no profile, a V1 bundle does not verify as V2: nothing to anchor.

cases.name: 4_pq_key_substituted_trust_only
cases.reason: Under the default policy with a trust set, someone else's ML-DSA key is unanchored too.

cases.name: 1_trusted_keys_under_another_human_id
cases.reason: Keys trusted for human:stranger-2 do not make human:stranger trusted.

cases.name: 2_attacker_uses_known_human_id
cases.reason: The known human_id with the attacker's own keys: every principal component is unanchored.

cases.name: 3_classical_key_substituted
cases.reason: The principal's PQ key with someone else's Ed25519 key: the classical components are unanchored.

cases.name: 4_pq_key_substituted
cases.reason: The principal's Ed25519 key with someone else's ML-DSA key: the PQ components are unanchored.

cases.name: 5_only_classical_key_trusted
cases.reason: Trusting only the Ed25519 key does not make the PQ key trusted.

cases.name: 5_only_pq_key_trusted
cases.reason: Trusting only the ML-DSA key does not make the Ed25519 key trusted.

cases.name: 6_key_revoked_in_trust_set
cases.reason: The bundle lists the key as active; the trust set, authoritative, has it revoked.

cases.name: 6_key_status_expired_in_trust_set
cases.reason: The trust set marks the PQ key expired.

cases.name: 6_key_expires_before_now
cases.reason: The trusted key expired one millisecond before now.

cases.name: 6_key_expires_exactly_now
cases.reason: expires_at equal to now is not before now: still valid.

cases.name: 8_no_intended_verifier
cases.reason: The signed manifest names no verifier.

cases.name: 8_other_intended_verifier
cases.reason: The signed manifest names another verifier.

cases.name: 8_profile_for_another_verifier
cases.reason: This verifier is not the one the bundle names.

cases.name: 9_no_session_issued_at
cases.reason: No signed session start.

cases.name: 9_no_session_expires_at
cases.reason: No signed session expiry.

cases.name: 10_session_300_s_exactly
cases.reason: A 300 s session is at the maximum: admitted (that is the base bundle).

cases.name: 10_session_301_s
cases.reason: A 301 s session exceeds the maximum.

cases.name: 10_session_300_001_s
cases.reason: One millisecond over the maximum, at millisecond precision.

cases.name: 10_operator_lowers_maximum
cases.reason: The operator lowered the maximum to 120 s: the 300 s session exceeds it.

cases.name: 10_expires_exactly_now
cases.reason: now equal to session_expires_at: not expired.

cases.name: 10_expired_one_ms_ago
cases.reason: now one millisecond after session_expires_at.

cases.name: 10_session_start_after_expiry
cases.reason: The signed session starts after it expires.

cases.name: 10_session_expiry_not_rfc3339
cases.reason: The signed session_expires_at is not an RFC 3339 timestamp.

cases.name: 10_sub_millisecond_digits_dropped
cases.reason: A 300.0009 s session is 300 s at millisecond precision: admitted.

cases.name: 10_start_30_s_ahead
cases.reason: session_issued_at 30 s after now is within the clock skew.

cases.name: 10_start_30_001_s_ahead
cases.reason: session_issued_at 30.001 s after now is beyond the clock skew.

cases.name: 11_v1_bundle
cases.reason: strict-v1 admits V2 bundles only; nothing else is evaluated.

cases.name: 11_classical_only_bundle
cases.reason: Classical-only signatures: the profile requires both components.

cases.name: 14_profile_narrows_pq_algs
cases.reason: The operator accepts only SLH-DSA-192f: a bundle signed with ML-DSA-65 does not verify.

cases.name: 14_profile_advisory_rejects_ml_dsa
cases.reason: An advisory the operator applies rejects ML-DSA-65.

cases.name: 14_profile_restates_fixed_values
cases.reason: Restating the fixed values and narrowing to ML-DSA-65 keeps the base bundle admitted.

cases.name: 12_pq_signature_present_and_invalid
cases.reason: The PQ signature over the manifest is present and invalid: verification fails in every mode.

cases.name: 13_agent_revoked
cases.reason: The agent is revoked.

cases.name: 13_principal_key_revoked
cases.reason: The principal's Ed25519 key is revoked in the snapshot.

cases.name: 13_agent_key_revoked
cases.reason: The agent's ML-DSA key is revoked in the snapshot.

cases.name: 13_status_unknown
cases.reason: The source says it does not know one key.

cases.name: 13_subject_missing
cases.reason: The snapshot does not cover the agent.

cases.name: 13_key_subject_missing
cases.reason: The snapshot does not cover one verified signer key.

cases.name: 13_stale_by_1_ms
cases.reason: checked_at 300.001 s before now.

cases.name: 13_age_exactly_300_s
cases.reason: checked_at exactly 300 s before now is not stale.

cases.name: 13_stale_and_revoked
cases.reason: A stale snapshot that marks the agent revoked reports both.

cases.name: 13_checked_30_s_ahead
cases.reason: checked_at 30 s after now is within the clock skew.

cases.name: 13_checked_30_001_s_ahead
cases.reason: checked_at 30.001 s after now: a snapshot dated in the future.

cases.name: 13_checked_at_not_rfc3339
cases.reason: checked_at is not an RFC 3339 timestamp.

cases.name: 13_status_not_in_schema
cases.reason: A status other than revoked, not_revoked or unknown.

cases.name: 13_extra_field
cases.reason: A field outside the schema.

cases.name: 13_unavailable
cases.reason: The source could not answer (timeout, error): no snapshot.
